content:
Regional Mexican music and equestrian tradition will join in the celebration of Nuevo Laredo's 178th anniversary, with the Cabalgata por Nuevo Laredo and a concert by the group Bronco scheduled for Saturday, Nov. 14, according to information released by the municipal government and reported by La Voz NLD on Oct. 25.

The horseback ride will begin at 4:00 p.m. at the SETASA roundabout, from where participants will advance to the Polyforum La Fe facilities. People interested in joining the ride or learning more about registration can contact the Tourism Department at 867 713 70 20.

Bronco will perform at 8:00 p.m. in the Polyforum La Fe parking lot. The group, known for its long career in grupera and norteño music, will be one of the day's main attractions, promising to draw fans from different generations.

The day is designed to bring Nuevo Laredo families together in a celebration combining community, tradition, and popular music, according to the municipal information. With this combination of music and tradition, Nuevo Laredo is preparing to celebrate its 178th anniversary with a day aimed at convening the community and keeping the region's customs alive.

So far, the information available does not specify the cost or the conditions of admission to the concert. Readers should watch official channels for additional details, mobility guidance, and possible program updates.

Sources:

  • La Voz NLD, "¡Bronco llegará a Nuevo Laredo! Anuncian cabalgata y concierto por el 178 aniversario de la ciudad," Oct. 25, 2026
